_schema: See methods/head_overlap.py load_published. heads are [layer, head] exactly as printed in the source; layer_base/head_base give the source's index convention (null = not stated, which makes head_overlap.py and vrh_ablation.py emit both readings). Checked against the arXiv e-print TeX on 2026-10-13.

lists.name: park_vrh
lists.paper: Park et al., Retrieval Heads Meet Vision (arXiv 2608.27417v1)
lists.where: sections/100_appendix.tex, RefCOCO head-list table (the main detection set); ordered by descending head score
lists.model: Qwen2.5-VL-7B (no HF id or Instruct suffix given; no code release)
lists.note: Heads 0-based: (16,0) appears. Layers 0-based only per a figure axis (crossmodel_three_pairs.pdf), so left null: vrh_ablation.py's index check decides. Score: mean over 200 RefCOCO val samples of the attention mass from output tokens onto visual tokens overlapping the GT box. Masking = zeroing the head output.

lists.name: park_vrh_internvl3
lists.paper: Park et al., Retrieval Heads Meet Vision (arXiv 2608.27417v1)
lists.where: sections/100_appendix.tex, RefCOCO head-list table, InternVL3-8B row

lists.name: lietzow_promoting
lists.where: acl_latex.tex, table 'All promoting attention heads (PCA > +2 sigma)', Qwen-VL 7B row; ordered by layer then head, not by score
lists.model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (from the code's MODEL_PATH_TEMPLATE; the paper cites the Qwen2-VL report)
lists.note: 0-based per their code (layer = i // n_heads over model.language_model.layers). Last-token patching between a 'what colour here' and a 'usually' prompt on 212 Visual-CounterFact items. Their promoting MLPs: 25 and 27.

lists.name: lietzow_writing
lists.where: NOT a printed list: read off logit_lens_all.pdf bar widths (top-20 hit rate, n=212); only L23H6 (87.7%) clears the paper's stated >80% writing criterion
lists.note: Derived, not quotable as theirs. Next by hit rate: L22H1 59.9%, L23H11 46.2%, L24H21 45.3%, L22H13 25.0%.
